Water Damage Restoration in Miami

Water damage is the single most common property emergency across South Florida, and Miami's hot, humid climate means damage escalates faster here than almost anywhere in the country. Whether you're a homeowner in Coral Gables with a burst pipe, a property manager in Hialeah dealing with flooding after a tropical downpour, or a business owner in Fort Lauderdale facing roof damage after a named storm, 911 Restoration responds 24/7 to extract water, dry your structure, and stop mold before it starts.

Flat terrain throughout much of Broward County, including Tamarac, Plantation, Sunrise, and Miramar, limits natural drainage and leaves standing water on properties far longer than it would elsewhere. Coastal properties in Palm Beach, Boca Raton, and Dania Beach face storm surge and saltwater intrusion requiring specialized treatment.

Water Damage Restoration Services

  • Inspection and damage assessment
  • Water extraction with industrial pumps
  • Structural drying and dehumidification
  • Cleaning and sanitization
  • Restoration and repairs

Common Causes of Water Damage in Miami

  • Hurricane and tropical storm flooding
  • Roof leaks from wind-driven rain
  • Plumbing failures in older buildings
  • Storm surge and saltwater intrusion
  • Poor drainage in Tamarac, Sunrise, Plantation
  • Appliance and water heater failures

Fire Damage Restoration in Miami

Fire damage in dense South Florida communities spreads quickly and affects more than just the property where it starts. Smoke penetrates shared walls, HVAC systems, and neighboring units in Hialeah apartment buildings, Coral Gables townhomes, and Fort Lauderdale commercial corridors. 911 Restoration provides comprehensive fire damage restoration throughout Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach, and St. Lucie counties, from emergency board-up through complete structural rebuilds.

Fire Restoration Services

  • Smoke and soot removal from all surfaces
  • Thermal fogging and ozone odor treatment
  • Structural assessment and repairs
  • Content cleaning and pack-out
  • Board-up and property security

What We Restore After Fire Damage

  • Walls, ceilings, and structural elements
  • HVAC systems and ductwork
  • Furniture and upholstery
  • Electronics and appliances
  • Personal belongings and documents

Mold Remediation in Miami

Mold is the defining property challenge of South Florida. Miami's average relative humidity, year-round warmth, and near-daily summer rainfall create conditions where mold can take hold within 24 to 48 hours of any water intrusion event. Properties in coastal communities like Palm Beach, Boca Raton, Dania Beach, and North Miami Beach face compounding moisture exposure from ocean air and tidal activity. Even inland communities like Hialeah, Miramar, and Tamarac experience serious mold growth after flooding or plumbing failures.

Our certified mold remediation specialists do not just remove visible mold. We identify and address the underlying moisture source to prevent recurrence, protecting your property's structure and your family's indoor air quality over the long term.

Mold Remediation Services

  • Professional inspection and testing
  • Containment to prevent spore spread
  • HEPA filtration and air scrubbing
  • Safe removal and antimicrobial treatment
  • Moisture source identification and repair

Signs You Need Mold Remediation

  • Musty or earthy odors
  • Visible mold growth on surfaces
  • Recent water damage or flooding
  • Allergy symptoms that worsen indoors
  • Discoloration or staining on walls

Sewage Cleanup in Miami

Raw sewage is a Category 3 biohazard containing bacteria, viruses, and parasites that pose immediate health risks. Sewage backups across South Florida are especially common following heavy rainfall that overwhelms older infrastructure in established Miami-Dade and Broward County neighborhoods. Septic systems in less densely developed areas of Palm Beach and St. Lucie counties face added risk after major storm events saturate drain fields. Our team responds 24/7 throughout the region.

Sewage Cleanup Process

  • Emergency sewage extraction
  • Contaminated material removal
  • Professional-grade sanitization
  • Odor removal treatment
  • Structural drying and restoration

Health Threats We Address

  • E. coli and harmful bacteria
  • Hepatitis and viral pathogens
  • Parasites and protozoa
  • Toxic gases and fumes
  • Secondary mold growth
⚠️ Warning: Never attempt sewage cleanup yourself. Contact our 24/7 emergency line immediately at (305) 744-0810 for safe, professional cleanup.

Storm Damage Restoration in Miami

Miami and South Florida sit at the front line of Atlantic hurricane season, facing the threat of named storms every year from June through November. Beyond direct hurricane strikes, the region contends with tropical storm flooding, storm surge along the Intracoastal Waterway and Atlantic coastline, and the persistent sheet flooding that overwhelms drainage systems in flat inland communities like Tamarac, Sunrise, Miramar, and Plantation after even moderate rainfall events. 911 Restoration responds immediately when severe weather strikes, day or night.

Storm Damage Services

  • Emergency board-up and tarping
  • Water extraction from storm flooding
  • Structural drying and dehumidification
  • Roof repairs and full replacement
  • Window and door restoration
  • Complete reconstruction

Types of Storm Damage We Handle

  • Hurricane and tropical storm damage
  • Storm surge and saltwater flooding
  • Wind damage to roofs
  • Sheet flooding and drainage overflow
  • Hail and wind-driven debris damage
  • Tornado and severe thunderstorm damage

Frequently Asked Questions

How quickly can you respond to a water damage emergency in Miami?
Our restoration team typically arrives within 45 minutes of your call anywhere across South Florida, including Miami, Fort Lauderdale, Hialeah, Coral Gables, Boca Raton, West Palm Beach, and Fort Pierce. We're available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including holidays and during active weather events. Call (305) 744-0810 for immediate assistance.
Does 911 Restoration work with insurance companies?
Yes. We work directly with all major insurance carriers and manage the documentation and claims process on your behalf. Our team bills your insurance company directly, reducing your out-of-pocket costs and simplifying your recovery.
How long does water damage restoration take in South Florida?
Most residential water damage restoration projects in the Miami area take 3 to 5 days depending on the extent of damage. South Florida's warm, humid climate can extend drying times compared to drier climates, and our team accounts for that on every project. We provide a detailed timeline after our initial on-site assessment.
What should I do while waiting for your team to arrive?
If it is safe to do so: shut off the water source, move valuables to dry areas, and avoid walking through standing water near electrical outlets or panels. Do not use household vacuums on standing water, and do not attempt mold removal yourself.
Do you offer free estimates for restoration services in Miami?
Yes. We provide free on-site assessments and estimates for all restoration services throughout South Florida. Call (305) 744-0810 to schedule your inspection.
What areas of South Florida do you serve?
We serve Miami, Hialeah, Coral Gables, North Miami Beach, Palmetto Bay, Fort Lauderdale, Dania Beach, Miramar, Plantation, Sunrise, Tamarac, Pompano Beach, Boca Raton, Delray Beach, West Palm Beach, Palm Beach, Mission Bay, Fort Pierce, and all surrounding communities throughout Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach, and St. Lucie counties.
